notes.title: Version 0.25.36
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The repair process of the buildings has been completed. Now all the structures can be repaired.
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can see the thoughts of the colonists. You will find information about what they do in the colonist panel. It is still in the early stages, it will be made more comprehensive.
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can learn why the colonists are stopped or not working.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Soon, you will be able to prioritize the tasks as you wish.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Many bug fixes have been made.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Please send us your feedback with your requests and suggestions.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.25.25
notes.content:
[b]The update fixes many bugs and brings new features. [/b]

[list]
[*]  Towers' vision fields,
[*]  Enemy detection and warning system,
[*]  Repair process in towers for now (soon to be in all buildings),
[*]  Directing to new targets after storage in wood and stone processes,
[*]  Smarter pathfinding,
[*]  Smart colonist guidance in item collection, 
[*]  Lots of minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.25.20
notes.content:
- The mission system has been adjusted.
- The work system has been adjusted.
- Water well construction areas have been adjusted. (In the next update, areas will be created within the mines. Mines cannot be installed everywhere.)
- And many small bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 0.25.13
notes.content:
- Navigation and pathfinding system has been completely changed.

- Fixed.
"When you click on a building to build, you get a popup with the resources needed to build it. It's very confusing that you can't close this popup and instead have to click on the house icon."

- Fixed.
"When you start and click on the hammer and wrench icon, it appears that you have 999 wood and 5 out of 10 people working on it. Beginners won't know that the inventory is displayed yet and will assume that they started with a large amount of logs."

- Fixed.
"When I first click on colonists, a name appears, it appears that I have one colonist (1 is idle) But after a short while the name flickers and changes to something else."

- Fixed.
"0 people appear to be assigned to the stone mine, but one colonist is still working?"

-Fixed.
"It was difficult to understand the colonists' assignments to buildings. We want to see this in the building information."

-Fixed.
"There are errors in the Hunter's Lodge assignments. Colonists are going to assignments without my permission."

- Lots of minor fixes...
